card.name: Word just before "Injection" in diluents
card.fires_on: The word "for" in "Water for Injection", and "ide" ending "Sodium Chloride" when "Injection" comes next. It appears in reconstitution and dilution instructions.

modes.label: Water for Injection
modes.description: The word "for" right after Sterile or Bacteriostatic Water, where "Injection" follows.
modes.example: Bacteriostatic Water<< for>> Injection or Bacteriostatic Sodium

modes.label: Sodium Chloride Injection
modes.description: The ending "ide" of Sodium Chloride in a list of diluents, before "Injection" or a comma.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "injection" (and its forms) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "Injection" in diluent names like Water for Injection or Sodium Chloride Injection.
